follow-on: the header records the invocation revision and the row-set predicates but omits the quantitative anchor-resolution count that plan §6 requires the census to follow from docs/evidence/reuse-map-residual-closure.md:30 (the six-rows, six-paths, six-anchors-resolved, zero-unresolved line), so a reader cannot tell how many of the census's cited anchors were resolved.
